The '''Lorardia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lorardia]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a survey team was charting an [[Unidentified planet (Lorardia system)|uninhabited planet]] in the system when they received unusual readings; the readings were determined to be caused by large deposits of [[maranium]] underneath the surface.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Strange Survey}}</ref>
